definitions.explanation: The area inside the boundary of a station, campus, factory or other facility.

examples.japanese: {構内|こうない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited on the premises.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構内|こうない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた→待ち合わせる：12328_machiawaseru⟧。

⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構内|こうない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Not only students but also people from the neighborhood come to walk on the university grounds.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧{構内|こうない}: inside the station
- {構内|こうない}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: public-address announcement (in a station or facility)
- {構内図|こうないず}: map of the station or premises
- {構内|こうない}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking on the premises

WATCH OUT:
⟦{校内|こうない}→校内：26870_kounai⟧ (inside a school) sounds the same. {構内|こうない} is the grounds of any facility, a station above all.
